aliases: 8MP DeepinViewX Fixed Lens Dome for Perimeter Protection

power.method: PoE (802.3at, Type 2, Class 4), max. 15.6W, or 12 VDC max. 15.6W

features: DeepinViewX 8MP fixed-lens dome with dedicated Guanlan large-scale AI model for perimeter protection (~90% fewer false alarms vs conventional AI cameras)
perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance, region exiting with human/vehicle target classification and combined-event triggering
AI Encoding to reduce bandwidth and storage
AcuSeek search for humans and vehicles (requires AcuSeek NVR/servers)
hybrid supplement light (IR + white light) up to 40 m
130 dB WDR, DarkFighter 2.0 low-light, blue-glass module, EIS
smart events: scene change, audio exception, defocus, unattended baggage, object removal, loitering, people gathering, fast moving, parking detection

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

release_notes: 8MP DeepinViewX fixed-lens (2.8/4mm, F1.0) dome for perimeter protection (Guanlan model). IP67/IK10, hybrid supplement light to 40m, 130dB WDR, AI Encoding, AcuSeek.
